function.name: FTMarshalCF_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches either IID_IUnknown or IID_IClassFactory. If it does, it assigns the interface to the provided pointer and increments the reference count of the interface. If it doesn't, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that needs to be queried

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: The interface ID to be checked

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer variable that receives the interface pointer

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the interface ID matches, E_NOINTERFACE otherwise

function.name: FTMarshalCF_AddRef
function.description: This function returns a constant value of 2, representing a non-heap based object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is an interface pointer of type LPCLASSFACTORY.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents a non-heap based object.

function.name: FTMarshalCF_Release
function.description: This function returns a static value of 1, indicating a non-heap based object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is an interface pointer used within the function.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents a non-heap based object.

function.name: FTMarshalCF_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of a free threaded marshaler.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the class factory interface.

parameters.name: pUnk
parameters.description: Pointer to the IUnknown interface of the object for which a proxy is being requested.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface that the caller is to use to communicate with the proxy.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppv contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface specified in riid, *ppv will be NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the function was successful, or an error HRESULT if the function failed.

function.name: FTMarshalCF_LockServer
function.description: This function is a stub and does not have a defined functionality yet. It currently returns S_OK regardless of the input parameters.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is not used in the current implementation of the function.

parameters.name: fLock
parameters.description: This parameter is not used in the current implementation of the function.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. In the current implementation, it always returns S_OK.

function.name: FTMarshalCF_Create
function.description: This function queries an interface of the FTMarshalCF class factory.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: This is the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the pointer that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the call to the function. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the function fails, it returns an error code.
